hand_derivations_no_code_required.derivation: Holm step-down requires the SMALLEST p-value in a family of m to clear alpha/m before any test in that family can be rejected; a two-sided permutation p-value against n null draws has floor 1/(n+1) by the (1+count)/(n+1) formula. Since 1/(n+1) > alpha/m unconditionally for n=200, m in [49,100], alpha=0.05, no draw's outcome (however extreme) can ever produce a Holm-significant result in this design.
